subject: System Design
title: Connection Pooling
description: A quick win: understand Connection Pooling.

hook.text: Opening a database connection takes 50ms. With 10,000 requests per second, that overhead is devastating.

buildup.text: Connection pooling pre-opens a set of connections and reuses them across requests.

discovery.text: Instead of open-use-close, it's borrow-use-return. Each request borrows from the pool instantly.

twist.text: Too few connections starve the app. Too many overwhelm the database. The pool size is a tuning art.

climax.text: Connection pooling is invisible when done right but catastrophic when misconfigured.

punchline.text: Reuse connections — don't rebuild them every time.

quiz.question: Why is connection pooling important?
options: It avoids the overhead of opening new connections for every request
